verified_context: The painting was inspired by the view from the artist's room at Saint-Paul-de-Mausole in Saint-Rémy.
The village in the painting could not be seen from the artist's window.
imagined_context: The compact village lane, nearby hill shoulder, cypress passage and connected camera route are an imagined spatial reconstruction, not a verified historical site.
visual_anchors: One dark cypress on the left of the final view
One church steeple in the lower central village
A low ridge behind the village
The moon in the upper right
Cobalt night light and warm yellow windows; real materials during flight

artwork_extension.prompt_en: Continue the original nocturnal landscape into both side extensions. Extend the existing ridge, village outskirts and blue swirling sky with the same oil-paint medium and scale. Keep the complete source rectangle at its exact position and size. Make seams continuous. Do not duplicate the cypress, church, moon or central swirl. No frame, flat color bars, text or new centerpiece.

keyframes.image_prompt_en: A cinematic night photograph from inside a compact nineteenth-century village lane. Rough stone walls and tiled roofs fill the near sides, warm windows illuminate cobbles, and a small distant steeple appears through a roof gap. Natural material detail, deep occlusion and a narrow view of luminous blue clouds. No broad panorama.

keyframes.image_prompt_en: Photographic close flight beside a rounded blue-lit hill shoulder. Near grass, rock and soil occupy the right 40 percent and obscure part of the village. The left opening shows layered rooftops and the same steeple below; a nearby tall cypress is ahead-left. Solid terrain with believable scale and atmospheric distance.

keyframes.image_prompt_en: Photographic view close to a cypress trunk at night. Rough bark fills the left 35 percent, separate needle clusters overlap at different depths, and the village is visible through a safe open passage to the right. The same church and ridge remain farther away. Real branches with depth, not a silhouette pasted on the sky.

keyframes.image_prompt_en: Cinematic photoreal night panorama just beyond the cypress passage. A few nearby cypress branches still cover the upper-left quarter. Below are the same village and small church, with the ridge behind and a moon upper-right. The final arrangement is almost established, but the nearest branches remain larger because the camera has not yet backed into its final position.

keyframes.image_prompt_en: Reconstruct the entire extended artwork as a cinematic photograph of a coherent nocturnal landscape. Keep the cypress silhouette on the left, the village and church below, the ridge behind, the moon upper-right, and the broad luminous cloud arc in corresponding positions. Render stone, roof tiles, bark, foliage and clouds as real materials with physical volume. Preserve dreamy cobalt and yellow lighting, but do not retain impasto, canvas texture, painted outlines, a flat picture plane or a rectangular insert.

shots.beat_zh: 巷道低飞后轻升，接近近处山肩。
shots.camera_path: 0–50% move forward through the short lane; 50–75% rise just above the low roof; 75–100% approach the nearby hill shoulder on the right
shots.speed_profile: steady modest speed, ease slightly near the hill
shots.parallax: walls slide fastest; roofs and distant ridge move progressively more slowly
shots.environment_motion: subtle leaf movement and warm window light
shots.transition_approach: The right-hand terrain grows to the R2 coverage and hides part of the village
shots.final_quarter_target_state: Exact R2 hill coverage and left opening
shots.motion_prompt_en: Follow one continuous physically plausible route through the lane and over one low roof to the nearby hill. Preserve real materials and near/far parallax.
shots.transition_zh: 以右侧山肩遮挡接入下一镜。

shots.beat_zh: 沿山肩绕出，靠近柏树右侧空隙。
shots.start_state: R2 close hill shoulder on the right
shots.camera_path: 0–45% skim beside the hill; 45–75% bank gently toward the nearby cypress; 75–100% settle beside its trunk on the right approach side
shots.speed_profile: smooth moderate speed, no sudden acceleration
shots.parallax: near hill sweeps fastest, trunk grows as it approaches, village stays farther away
shots.environment_motion: grass and cypress needles move slightly
shots.transition_approach: The hill clears while the cypress trunk enters the left side
shots.final_quarter_target_state: Exact R3 trunk on left 35% with open passage on the right
shots.motion_prompt_en: Move from the same hill shoulder toward the nearby cypress, using natural terrain and trunk occlusion. Do not orbit the whole town or teleport across the valley.
shots.transition_zh: 山肩移出后由柏树接力遮挡。

shots.beat_zh: 掠过树干，从真实枝叶空隙中穿出。
shots.start_state: R3 beside cypress, safe opening on right
shots.camera_path: 0–60% move through the open right-hand branch gap without touching wood; 60–100% emerge toward the village view
shots.speed_profile: slow precise glide through the gap
shots.parallax: individual branches pass at different speeds and uncover distant roofs
shots.environment_motion: needles move gently in the breeze
shots.transition_approach: Keep the trunk and final branches on the left as the view opens
shots.final_quarter_target_state: Exact R4 partial upper-left branch coverage and same horizon
shots.motion_prompt_en: Fly through an actual open gap between branches. Near foliage occludes the distant village and reveals it again. Maintain real depth, no painted panel and no branch melting.

shots.beat_zh: 小幅后退校正构图，平稳停在原画对应视角。
shots.start_state: R4 panorama with enlarged near-left branches
shots.camera_path: 0–60% drift backward a few metres; 60–75% make a small lateral framing correction; 75–95% progressively brake into the exact R5 pose; 95–100% hold the camera completely fixed
shots.speed_profile: progressive deceleration to a complete stop
shots.parallax: near cypress changes fastest while village and ridge barely shift
shots.environment_motion: faint cloud drift and gentle foliage motion
shots.transition_approach: Branches retreat to the final left silhouette without crossing the full image
shots.final_quarter_target_state: Complete alignment and deceleration into R5, with approximately the final six frames already stationary; remain fully photoreal
shots.motion_prompt_en: Finish the physical camera move and stop on the photoreal endpoint. Do not begin painting transformation, add brushstrokes or reveal a canvas during this flight.
shots.transition_zh: 停稳后由独立画作化段接续。

morph.material_progression_en: 0–20% keep the photographic pose fixed as colors begin to organize; 20–65% stone, foliage and clouds develop coherent pigment and brushstroke structure on their surfaces; 65–95% the cloud arc and light halos settle into the artwork shapes; 95–100% converge to the supplied extended artwork. Both sides transform together.
morph.motion_prompt_en: The camera has already stopped. Maintain the same perspective, horizon and major landmark positions throughout. Physical materials progressively become the exact visual language of the last frame. Transform the scene itself; do not slide a painting in front of it, crossfade transparent duplicate buildings, grow a picture frame or perform another camera move.
